source("HelperFunctions/ProjectPowell.R")

```{r server, include=FALSE}
server<- function(input, output, session){

# Time frame set up
start_date <- as.Date("2026-10-01")
time_step_lengths <- c(0, 3, 3, 6)

#Inflow scenario set up
possible_inflows <- c(2.177, 5.142, 5.934)
inflow <- sample(possible_inflows, 1)

# Initial state for initial message
current_storage <- 5.1
current_elevation <- 3517
current_date <- reactiveVal(start_date)

# Initial message
start_description <- 
  HTML(
              paste0("The Current Date is: ", format(start_date, "%B %d"),
             "<br/>The Current Storage of Lake Powell is: ", current_storage," MAF",
             "<br/>The Current Elevation of Lake Powell is: ", current_elevation," ft.",
             
             "<br/><br/> Make operating decisions for the next 3 months."
              )
    )
observeEvent(TRUE,{  
  showModal(
    modalDialog(title = "Welcome!", start_description)
  )
}, once = TRUE)

submitted <- reactiveVal(
data.frame(release = 0, add_flow = 0, time_step = 0)
  )

# Defines projection as a value reactive to submitted
projection <- reactive({
  req(submitted()$time_step > 0)
  choices <- submitted()
  print(paste(
    "PROJECTING:",
    "step =", max(choices$time_step),
    "release =", paste(choices$release, collapse = ","),
    "add_flow =", paste(choices$add_flow, collapse = ",")
  ))
      
    time_idx <- max(choices$time_step) + 1
 
    result<- ProjectPowell(
        Inflow = inflow,
        Inflow_Time = sum(time_step_lengths),
        Release = choices$release,
        Release_Time = time_step_lengths[1:time_idx],
        Add_Release = choices$add_flow,
        Add_Time = time_step_lengths[1:time_idx],
        Storage_Data = hydrodata,
        start_date = start_date
      )
    
      # Checks if Powell is empty
      if (identical(result, "crashed")) {
        showModal(
          modalDialog(
            title = "Empty!",
            "Lake Powell is empty! It's Active Storage is zero!",
            easyClose = TRUE,
            footer = actionButton("restart_button","Try Again")
            )
        )
      return(NULL)
      }
  result
})



##### When Next button is pushed
  #Stores input values after next page button is pushed
  observeEvent(input$next_step, {
     print(paste(
    "\nNEXT STEP\n",
    "submitted time_step:",
    max(submitted()$time_step),
    "\n"
  ))
    
    current <- submitted()
    
    new_choice <- data.frame(
      release = as.numeric(input$release),
      add_flow = as.numeric(input$add_flow),
      time_step = max(current$time_step) + 1
    )
    # If the user does not input something, assume 0
    new_choice[is.na(new_choice)]<- 0
    
    submitted(
      rbind(current, new_choice)
    )
    
    # Clears Input Boxes
    updateTextInput(session, "release", value = "")
    updateTextInput(session, "add_flow", value = "")
  
  })

  
  # Modal logic
  observeEvent(projection(),{
    req(length(submitted()$time_step) > 1)
    result <- projection() 
    print(paste(
  "NEXT_STEP SECOND OBSERVER:",
  max(submitted()$time_step),
  "\n"
))
    # Shows end of game summary if at the end of the time horizon
    if (max(submitted()$time_step) == length(time_step_lengths)){
  
      current_storage <- result$storage[[length(result$storage)]] / 1000000
      current_elevation <- result$elevation[[length(result$elevation)]]
      current_date(max(result$datetime))
      
      showModal(
        modalDialog(
          title = "Congratulations!",
          "You've reached the end of the game! The state of Lake Powell at the end of the reservoir is: ",
          easyClose = FALSE,
          footer = actionButton("restart_button", "Try Again?")
        )
      )
  } 
  # Checks if Powell hits minimum power pool
  else if (any(result$elevation <= 3490, na.rm = TRUE)) {
      showModal(
        modalDialog(
          title = "Minimum Power Pool!",
          "Lake Powell hit minimum power pool! The reservoir's elevation was too low to generate power!",
          easyClose = FALSE,
          footer = actionButton("next_modal", "Continue")
        )
      )
    }
    
    # Checks if Powell hits 3500
    else if(any(result$elevation <= 3500, na.rm = TRUE)) {
      showModal(
        modalDialog(
          title = "Below Protection Elevation!",
          "Lake Powell is below the Final EIS Protection Elevation (3500 ft)!",
          easyClose = FALSE,
          footer = actionButton("next_modal", "Continue")
        )
      )
    }
    # Shows end of time step message
    else{
      current_storage <- result$storage[[length(result$storage)]] / 1000000
      current_elevation <- result$elevation[[length(result$elevation)]]
      
      current_date(max(result$datetime))
      
      title <- paste0("Current Date: ", format(current_date(), "%B %d"))
      
      description<-
        HTML(
          paste0("The Current Date is: ", current_date(),
             "<br/>The Current Storage of Lake Powell is: ", round(current_storage, digits = 1), " MAF",
             "<br/>The Current Elevation of Lake Powell is: ", current_elevation, " ft.",
             
             "<br/><br/> Make operating decisions for the next ", time_step_lengths[max(submitted()$time_step)], 
             " months."
             )
        )
      showModal(
        modalDialog(title = title, description)        
      )
    }
      
      # Restarts app if the user clicks the restart button
      observeEvent(input$restart_button,{
      restart_app()
    })
  })
  
  
  # Shows Pop up message if a warning modal came up and was closed
    observeEvent(input$next_modal, {
      removeModal() #Removes warning modals
      
      result <- projection()
      
      current_storage <- result$storage[[length(result$storage)]] / 1000000
      current_elevation <- result$elevation[[length(result$elevation)]]
      time_step_idx <- max(submitted()$time_step)
      current_date(max(result$datetime))
      
      title <- paste0("Current Date: ", format(current_date(), "%B %d"))
      
      description<-
        HTML(
          paste0("The Current Date is: ", current_date(),
             "<br/>The Current Storage of Lake Powell is: ", round(current_storage, digits = 1), " MAF",
             "<br/>The Current Elevation of Lake Powell is: ", current_elevation, " ft.",
             
             "<br/><br/> Make operating decisions for the next ", time_step_lengths[time_step_idx], 
             " months."
             )
        )
      
      showModal(
        modalDialog(title = title, description)        
      )
    })  
      

#Plots Projection
    key_elev_df <- data.frame(elevation = c(3490, 3500), label = c("Top of Penstocks: 3490 ft.","Final EIS Critical Elevation: 3500 ft"))
    output$projection_plot <- renderPlot({
      req(length(submitted()$time_step) > 1)
      req(current_date() == max(projection()$datetime))
      fplotprojection(projection(), key_elev_df)
      })
      
    #Updates current state text
    output$current_state <- renderUI({
      #Pulls reactive projection to static values
      req(length(submitted()$time_step) > 1)
      req(current_date() == max(projection()$datetime))
      current_proj <- projection()
       print(paste(
    "RENDERING STATE:",
    "submitted step =", max(submitted()$time_step),
    "projection final storage =",
    tail(current_proj$storage, 1)
  ))
      
      current_storage <- current_proj$storage[[length(current_proj$storage)]] / 1000000
      current_elevation <- current_proj$elevation[[length(current_proj$elevation)]]
      projection_date <- max(current_proj$datetime)
      
      
      #Renders Text
      HTML(paste0(
          "<b>Current Storage: </b>", round(current_storage, digits = 1) , " MAF<br/>",
          "<b>Current Elevation: </b>", current_elevation, " ft<br/>",
          "<b>Current Date: </b>", projection_date
          ))
    })
    
  # Updates Year to Date
    output$ytd <- renderUI({
      req(length(submitted()$time_step) > 1)
      current_proj <- projection()
      
      # Calculates year to date values and filters to most recent
      annual_releases <- fAnnualValues(current_proj, "outflow", hydrodata)
      ytd_release <- annual_releases$'Release volume (MAF)'[[length(annual_releases$water_year)]]
      
      annual_inflow <-fAnnualValues(current_proj, "inflow", hydrodata)
      ytd_inflow <- annual_inflow$'Inflow Volume (MAF)'[[length(annual_releases$water_year)]]
      
      # HTML output
      HTML(paste0(
          "<b> Total Release to Date: </b>", round(ytd_release, digits = 1) , " MAF<br/>
          <b> Total Inflow to Powell to Date: </b>", round(ytd_inflow, digits = 1), "MAF"
          ))
    })



# Restart App logic
restart_app <- function() {
  updateNumericInput(session, "release", value = 0)
  updateNumericInput(session, "add_flow", value = 0)
  updateSelectInput(session, "time_step", selected = 1)
  submitted(data.frame(release = 0, add_flow = 0, time_step = 0))
  
  inflow <- sample(possible_inflows, 1)
  
  removeModal()
  
  #Welcome message
  observeEvent(TRUE,{  
  showModal(
    modalDialog(title = "Welcome!", start_description)
  )
}, once = TRUE)
}




}

```

```{r ui, include=FALSE}
ui <- fluidPage(
  img(src = "images/DurationFigure.png", height = "250px"),
  
  sidebarLayout(
    
    sidebarPanel(
      textInput("release", "Release Rate (MAF/yr): "),
      #uiOutput("total_release"),
      textInput("add_flow", "Additional Flow (MAF): "),
      actionButton("next_step", "Next"),
      uiOutput("ytd")
    ),
    
    mainPanel(
      uiOutput("current_state"),
      plotOutput("projection_plot")
    )  
  )
)
```

addResourcePath("images", file.path(getwd(),"www"))
shinyApp(ui = ui, server = server)
